data.title: 爱宕 · 海滨遮阳伞下的防晒互动
data.description: 碧海蓝天下白色遮阳伞下，身着纯白比基尼的爱宕跪坐在沙滩垫上。她手持防晒乳液，眉眼弯弯地俯身为你涂抹肩颈，雪白肌肤与碧蓝海水在阳光下交相辉映。
data.action: kneeling on beach towel holding sunscreen bottle, smiling warmly while applying lotion to partner shoulder, bright turquoise sea in background
data.lighting: brilliant tropical summer sunlight with blue sea reflections
data.mood: radiant summer romance, playful intimacy, sun-kissed happiness
data.promptProse: Kneeling on a beach mat under a parasol, Atago applies sunscreen to partner shoulder with an affectionate loving smile by the turquoise sea.
